verdict.rationale: Undermind's core product is an in-product AI research agent. You hand it an open-ended research goal and it plans its own searches, follows citations, and stops when it finds nothing new (docs-4, docs-16). It asks clarifying follow-ups (docs-37) and offers brainstorming and custom table generation with an AI expert that has read the literature (docs-39). Hands-on reports confirm that delegated searches return ranked, annotated results after useful follow-up questions (comm-5, comm-8, comm-16, comm-17). Missing for 10: delegation is limited to literature-research tasks rather than general tasks; in-app chat/brainstorm assistant capabilities are described only in thin marketing copy rather than detailed docs; independent reports note very long query latency (comm-10, comm-14).
